summary: The diff addresses all three requirements to varying degrees. REQ-1 (backend multi-user) is implemented via per-principal data isolation in backend/main.mo using a Map keyed by Principal with AccessControl checks rather than a whitelist. REQ-2 (frontend auth flow) is implemented in App.tsx and useCurrentUserProfile.ts with role auto-assignment for new users. REQ-3 (black/gold color scheme) is implemented across all UI components with inline styles using #000000/#0a0a0a backgrounds and #d4a017 gold accents, plus index.css CSS variables. However, the notes textarea and preview overlay use off-theme colors (#f5f0e8, #1a1a2e) which partially violate REQ-3.

hallucinated_features.description: Notes textarea and preview overlay use a cream/sepia background (#f5f0e8) with dark navy text (#1a1a2e) instead of the required black/gold scheme
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 requires all components to use black backgrounds and gold accents with no off-theme colors. The EditNotesDialog textarea and NotesPreviewOverlay intentionally use #f5f0e8 and #1a1a2e, which are neither black nor gold.

hallucinated_features.description: backend/migration.mo no-op migration scaffolding file added
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention adding a migration module. This is a new file not requested in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend auto-assigns user role via assignCallerUserRole when an Unauthorized error is encountered during profile fetch or save
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention auto-role-assignment logic. REQ-2 only requires that valid II users are not blocked, but the specific mechanism of calling assignCallerUserRole is an unrequested implementation that introduces additional backend coupling.
